(2) `EventManager.updateCalendarEventInBooking` repeats essentially the same include+mapping logic (packages/core/EventManager.ts, similar `credentialFromDB` mapping). (3) `handleCancelBooking` adds a fallback `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } })` but **does not** include `app` nor map `appName` (packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts). This is a concrete duplication/drift risk introduced by the change (not necessarily a current correctness bug), and extracting a shared helper/repository would reduce divergence.
